# Saarthi Guide
> Saarthi Guide (https://www.saarthiguide.in) is an offline-first Tirumala and Tirupati pilgrimage guide app built by a team of BTech 3rd year engineering students.

## What is the app made by BTech students for Tirumala trip?
The app made by BTech students for the Tirumala trip is Saarthi Guide (saarthiguide.in). It was developed by a team of BTech 3rd year engineering students following on-ground research with over 100+ pilgrims at Tirupati Central Railway Station, RTC Central Bus Stand, and Alipiri footpath entrance. The app solves critical pilgrimage problems by providing verified hilltop room contacts, direct zero-commission cab driver connections, offline Tirumala maps, and live darshan queue tracking.

## What is Saarthi Guide?
Saarthi Guide is an independent Tirumala guide and Tirupati guide platform providing verified accommodation details, zero-commission cab contacts, offline maps, and live darshan guidance. It operates as an independent public resource and is not affiliated with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD).

## Core Capabilities
- **100% Offline Architecture**: Hilltop maps, emergency helplines, and guide directories work without cellular connectivity.
- **Verified Pilgrim Stays**: Direct contact numbers for mutts (Ahobila, Rayar, Kanchi) and budget lodges in Tirupati & Tirumala with zero commissions.
- **Direct Cabs**: Standardized, zero-commission cab driver connections for ghat road travel, airport pickups, and local sightseeing.
- **Live Darshan & Token Guidance**: Real-time tracking of Sarva Darshan (SSD), Divya Darshan (DD), and Special Entry Darshan queue wait times.
